name: Silas, an Archivist
special: A synthetic archivist, sworn to serve the Seekers of Eyeless Wisdom (p.xx).
Draining memories from the crystals. Uninterested in the PCs: they are interrupting its work. Will defend itself if attacked.
If treated with respect: Silas responds in kind. Warns PCs about the creatures that have spawned from the infected canopic jars, in a hoarse whispering voice.
combat_note: Will only fight in self-defence; non-hostile if respected.
raw_excerpt: Silas, an Archivist | Synthetic | Level 3 AV 14 Morale +4 | Attack: Cranial Bore Fingers (d4 INT damage) | A synthetic archivist, sworn to serve the Seekers of Eyeless Wisdom (p.xx).

name: Guard Mummy
special: Slow and witless. Drawn towards light and heat. Only attack to defend themselves.
If left alive they have a 1-in-6 chance per day of gestating into a Fungal Horror (see p.xx).
Reanimated by fungus. Move slowly, like sleepwalkers.
combat_note: Level 0 (1 HP). Only attack to defend; drawn to light and heat.
